SELECT s.show_id AS showId, s.title AS title, s.start_date AS startDate, s.end_date AS endDate, s.venue_name AS venueName, s.poster_url AS posterUrl, COUNT(p.seat_id) AS reserveCount FROM ticket_payment_tbl p JOIN show_tbl s ON p.show_id = s.show_id WHERE p.ticket_status = 'APPROVED'
AND s.genre LIKE '%대중음악%'
AND s.genre LIKE '%뮤지컬%'
AND s.genre LIKE '%연극%'
GROUP BY s.show_id, s.title, s.start_date, s.end_date, s.venue_name, s.poster_url ORDER BY reserveCount DESC
